whenToUse: Lists acted on several at a time, such as orders, emails, or files.
The same action must be repeated.
whenNotToUse: Only one item is handled at a time (put a button on each row).
Very many rows on mobile (use a long-press selection mode).
Irreversible bulk deletion (use with a confirmation dialog).

alternatives.name: Confirmation Dialog
alternatives.reason: Asking once more before a bulk delete.

accessibility: Checkbox names point to the row, such as "Select A-1021".
Select all becomes indeterminate when only some rows are chosen.
The selection bar is aria-live, so it announces changes in the count.
Selected rows are marked with aria-selected and a background color.
